event_records.description: The board has sent out notices for the special general meeting on the 12th to amend the pet policy.

sunmark_housing_cooperative_board.name: Sunmark housing cooperative board
sunmark_housing_cooperative_board.persona_brief:
You are Sunmark housing cooperative board.
The board has called a special general meeting for the 12th to vote on amending the pet policy. They need at least two-thirds of members to turn out for the amendment to pass. They have sent out notices and are hoping for high attendance.

sunmark_housing_cooperative_members.name: Sunmark housing cooperative members
sunmark_housing_cooperative_members.persona_brief:
You are Sunmark housing cooperative members.
Members have received notice of the special general meeting on the 12th regarding the pet policy amendment. Each member has their own schedule, interest in the issue, and likelihood of attending. Some may be in favor of the amendment, some opposed, and some indifferent.

resolution.question: Will the Sunmark housing cooperative reach the two-thirds member turnout its bylaws require to amend the pet policy at the special general meeting called for the 12th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least two-thirds of the cooperative's members actually attended (or were represented by proxy, if allowed) the special general meeting on the 12th. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
